# Credits and license provenance

**Project author and maintainer:** ZombieDolphin.

BadUSB MSC is an independent, GPL-3.0-licensed application built from and adapted with components from:

- **Flipper Devices — flipperzero-firmware**: https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware (BadUSB implementation, screens, DuckyScript, icons and layouts).
- **Flipper Devices — flipperzero-good-faps**: https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-good-faps (Mass Storage / SCSI code).

Additional composite-HID glue, FAT16 synchronisation and file-management integration were added for this project. The bundled source includes the upstream-derived components needed to build this app; they may not be relicensed as proprietary code. Flipper Zero, qFlipper and Unleashed are names associated with their respective projects. This community application is not endorsed by Flipper Devices or the Unleashed team. The original BadUSB icon is reused as requested; ensure compliance with catalog branding/trademark requirements before submission.

Extra layout variants in this release are derived from the xkeyboard-config project (xkb-data 2.42-1); original upstream license notices are reproduced in `docs/XKB_DATA_LICENSE.txt`. The variants are not represented as official Windows or official Flipper layouts.
